title: Tumor Intrinsic METTL5 Modulates ATF4 Translation to Prevent T Cell-Induced Ferroptosis in Ovarian Cancer
model: ID8/GC mouse ovarian cancer cells, genome-wide knockout, co-culture with pmel T cells
contrast: T cells at effector:target 1 vs no T cells (3 vs 4)
paper_calls: Mettl5 chosen by integrating screens with clinical data
verdict: BARCS and the authors' MAGeCK agree closely on this T-cell killing screen (20 of the top 25 genes shared): antigen presentation and interferon genes protect, Rnf31 and Cflar knockouts sensitize. Mettl5 is a modest hit in both, consistent with the paper selecting it through clinical data rather than screen rank.
